prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers.

summary:
[reference generation] At dusk in an open-plan office, a coworker passing by waves to <Subject 1> at his desk and he answers with a small smile and nod, while his inner voice speaks off-screen.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, lean build, plain gray crew-neck T-shirt and unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, soft highlight roll-off and restrained contrast. The palette is cool blue-gray, with the last warm orange light of sunset on the horizon.
[Shot 1] A medium shot of a contemporary open-plan office at dusk. Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the background, showing a city skyline of glass towers under a fading blue sky, with a thin band of orange light at the horizon and the first office lights coming on in the buildings outside. Rows of light wooden desks with black monitors run toward the windows. <Subject 1> sits at his desk in the right third of the frame, framed from the waist up and turned three-quarters toward the camera, his face clearly visible and in focus. He wears his plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under the unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt; his short black hair is neat and natural. On his desk are an open silver laptop, a white coffee cup and a closed black notebook. In the softly blurred background, two coworkers stand up, sling bags over their shoulders and walk toward the exit on the left. A third coworker, a young man in a light-blue shirt with a black bag over his shoulder, walks past behind the desk from left to right, slows for a moment and gives a friendly wave. <Subject 1> looks up from his laptop, answers with a small, natural smile and a nod, and then turns his eyes back to the laptop screen; the gesture is relaxed and ordinary. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward <Subject 1> across the entire shot. Cool light from the windows falls on the side of his face, and the warm glow of the laptop screen lights his hands. <Subject 1> (S1), in a clean, natural, slightly low-pitched male voice of a man in his late twenties, relaxed and reflective, says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] After I started working, I realized...</d> while his lips remain completely closed. His expression stays calm and neutral throughout. Computer screens, papers and notebooks show no readable text, and there is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet office ventilation hums under faint keyboard clicks and distant footsteps. A bag zipper closes and a chair rolls back somewhere behind him.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music: sustained synth pads at a slow tempo with a soft, steady low pulse entering underneath, kept low in volume.
